title: BHU holds dialogue on AI in research, calls for on-ground fieldwork
description: BHU's Journalism Department held a dialogue on AI's impact on research, calling for ethical use and on-ground fieldwork. Experts advised researchers to prioritize originality and critical thinking over excessive reliance on technology.

title: AI Adoption Higher in Developed Nations, Job Openings Slowing Down
description: Developed economies lead in AI adoption (15-20%), while emerging markets lag (10-15%). This trend has caused a slowdown in job openings in highly exposed sectors like tech and call centres, particularly in the US, Germany, and Australia.
